snapshot.summary: Domestic grievances mobilised French protesters while a narrow humanitarian arrangement helped Ukrainians leave occupation. At the G20, practical cooperation remained possible despite deep political divisions.
connections: Limited agreements can have practical value even when wider political settlements remain distant.
Protest participation and evacuation totals require careful attribution to the authorities or reporters who supplied them.
uncertainties: Same-day reports evolved; the historical text at cutoff was not captured.
Neither a local evacuation truce nor a maritime proposal establishes a general peace agreement.

stories.title: France's third protest weekend combines peaceful marches with clashes
stories.summary: Large demonstrations continued over living costs and education. Authorities reported lower participation than the previous weekend; clashes in several cities complicated an otherwise largely peaceful daytime mobilisation.
stories.whyItMatters: The protests put public services, policing and fiscal choices under simultaneous pressure.
stories.selectionRationale: A sustained national movement with consequences for public order and government policy.
stories.evidenceNote: Participation figures are official estimates, not an independent census. AP's evolving Saturday account has no clear final update time; overnight totals are excluded.

stories.title: Evacuees from occupied Oleshky reach Ukrainian-held territory
stories.summary: Residents reached Ukrainian-controlled territory after a local ceasefire enabled evacuation and aid deliveries. Their accounts described severe deprivation; the operation's full scale remained uncertain.
stories.whyItMatters: The arrivals demonstrate a concrete humanitarian opening within a continuing war.
stories.selectionRationale: A consequential completed evacuation, distinct from earlier negotiations over whether it could proceed.
stories.evidenceNote: Eyewitness reporting supports the arrivals. Personal accounts and official statements remain attributed; no final evacuation total is asserted.

stories.title: G20 ministers close Atlanta talks without a joint agreement
stories.summary: Foreign ministers ended their meeting without a common statement. Washington discussed narrower maritime cooperation while European officials challenged Russia's account of the war.
stories.whyItMatters: Divisions among major economies complicate efforts to protect shipping, energy supplies and diplomatic cooperation.
